# Hawk Stars NGO — Associação HawkStars

> Hawk Stars is a Portuguese non-profit (NGO) based in Pinhel, Portugal, dedicated to education, social innovation, cultural development, and international cooperation. Our flagship initiative is The Global Village Project.

## About

Hawk Stars NGO (Associação HawkStars) was founded to foster positive change in Pinhel and beyond. We operate across education, entrepreneurship, technology, cultural development, and youth empowerment through Erasmus+ programmes and local community projects.

- Website: https://hawkstars.org
- Languages: Portuguese (primary), English
- Location: Pinhel, Portugal
- Type: Non-profit / NGO

## The Global Village Project

The Global Village is Hawk Stars' flagship initiative — a visionary project in Pinhel to build an International Training Center that fosters learning, innovation, entrepreneurship, e-sports, and cultural development. It aims to redefine urban landscapes and create a sustainable, inclusive community hub.

## Erasmus+ & International

Hawk Stars actively participates in Erasmus+ programmes, facilitating international youth exchanges, mobility projects, and European cooperation focused on education, inclusion, and cultural exchange.

## How to Contribute

Supporters can donate via bank transfer or cryptocurrency, sponsor chairs for the training center, or explore branding partnership opportunities. Visit https://hawkstars.org/pt/contribute for details.
